units.source_text: “容貌似舅，潘安仁之外甥；气调如兄，崔季珪之小妹。”

en.t: "Her looks resemble her uncle, like Pan Anren's nephew; her bearing is like her brother's, like Cui Jigui's younger sister."

units.source_text: 亦《游仙窟》中句，是十娘的侍女描写十娘的相貌。

en.t: This too is a line from Youxian Ku, spoken by Shiniang's maid as she describes Shiniang's appearance.

units.source_text: 中将君引用此典，意思是说：匂亲王乃大公主之弟，

en.t: When Chujo no Kimi cites this allusion, she means that Prince Niou is the elder princess's younger brother,

units.source_text: 你要看大公主，只要看匂亲王，但他不在这里。

en.t: so if you want to see the elder princess, you need only look at Prince Niou, though he is not here.

units.source_text: 薰大将引用此典，意思是说：我是大公主之母舅，故不妨亲见大公主。

en.t: When General Kaoru cites the same allusion, he means that since he is the elder princess's maternal uncle, there is no harm in seeing her in person.
